buttonGroup.description: Connect related actions into a compact horizontal or vertical control without changing their button semantics.
buttonGroup.basicDescription: Use connected buttons for actions that belong to one local tool or command family. Keep ordinary form actions separated when their priorities differ.
buttonGroup.splitDescription: Keep the default action immediately available and place less common variations in an adjacent menu.
buttonGroup.iconDescription: Icon-only groups stay compact. Give every button its own accessible name and tooltip.
buttonGroup.addonDescription: Use ButtonGroupText for compact context that belongs to the adjacent action, such as a status or selected count.
buttonGroup.verticalDescription: Vertical groups work well in narrow action panels while preserving the same connected treatment.
buttonGroup.accessibilityGroup: Give each ButtonGroup an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the surrounding context does not already name it.
buttonGroup.accessibilityKeyboard: ButtonGroup keeps native button keyboard behavior: Tab moves through independent actions, while Enter and Space activate the focused button.
buttonGroup.accessibilitySelection: For one-of-many selection or content navigation, use RadioGroup or Tabs instead of adding selected state or arrow-key behavior here.
buttonGroup.orientationDescription: Direction used to connect and stack direct children.
buttonGroup.ariaLabelDescription: Accessible name for the related action group.
buttonGroup.textChildrenDescription: Compact non-interactive context displayed beside grouped actions.
buttonGroup.separatorOrientationDescription: Direction of the divider itself. Use vertical inside a horizontal group and horizontal inside a vertical group.
